title: Add validation and status-partitioning to InMemoryMemoryStore test double
description: InMemoryMemoryStore.Save() accepts any MemoryRecord without validation, while the real FileMemoryStore enforces validation. Tests using InMemoryMemoryStore may pass with invalid records that would be rejected in production. Also, InMemoryMemoryStore uses a flat Dictionary keyed by ID, while real FileMemoryStore partitions records by MemoryStatus into subdirectories — indexing logic tested against the in-memory store may not surface directory-based partitioning bugs. Add validation mirroring the real store and an optional status-partitioning variant. Source: codebase-audit-20260710-swarm-synthesis P2-047/048

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Approved for Wave 1, execution order 07 of 09. Aligning the in-memory test double with production validation improves test fidelity with limited scope.
